workarounds.symptom: GrokModel.generate/a_generate pass an OpenAI-style list-of-dicts to xai_sdk.chat.user(), so every call crashes with a protobuf TypeError before any network I/O
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(grok): pass str to xai_sdk.chat.user(), use SDK Content for multimodal. Target files: deepeval/models/llms/grok_model.py, tests/test_core/test_models/test_grok_model.py. - `generate()` and `a_generate()` were building an OpenAI-style list-of-dicts (`[{"type": "text", "text": prompt}]`) and passing that list to `xai_sdk.chat.user()`. The xai_sdk `user()` function only accepts `str | chat_pb2.Content`, so every call crashed with a protobuf `TypeError` before any network I/O. - Fix: pass the plain prompt string direct... (Ref: https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval/pull/3437)

workarounds.symptom: LiteLLMModel sends temperature=0.0 by default, causing o-series and Claude Opus 5.5 to fail before making requests
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(litellm): omit default temperature to prevent failures on reasoning models. Target files: deepeval/models/llms/litellm_model.py, tests/test_core/test_models/test_litellm_model.py, docs/content/integrations/models/litellm.mdx. `LiteLLMModel` previously defaulted `temperature` to `0.0` unconditionally, forwarding `temperature: 0.0` into every LiteLLM completion request. This caused client-side parameter validation exceptions (`UnsupportedParamsError`) when evaluating reasoning models (such as OpenAI's `o1` / `o3` ser... (Ref: https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval/pull/3431)

Fix: fix(dataset): treat null tools as empty in add_test_cases_from_json_file. Target files: deepeval/dataset/dataset.py, tests/test_core/test_datasets/test_dataset.py. `add_test_cases_from_json_file` crashed with `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable` when a JSON object had `"tools_called": null` or `"expected_tools": null`, which is what `save_as("json")` writes for goldens without tools. (Ref: https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval/pull/3470)

workarounds.symptom: MCP 2.x CallToolResult exposes structured_content, so turn_mcp_interaction_text crashes MCP metrics
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: read MCP 2.x structured_content in tool interactions. Target files: deepeval/metrics/mcp/utils.py, tests/test_metrics/test_mcp_utils.py. `mcp>=2` exposes `CallToolResult.structured_content` (snake_case). The camelCase `structuredContent` constructor alias still works, but it is no longer an attribute. `turn_mcp_interaction_text` read `tool.result.structuredContent["result"]` directly, so `MCPTaskCompletionMetric` and `MultiTurnMCPUseMetric` crashed with `AttributeError: 'CallToolResult' object has no attribute 'st... (Ref: https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval/pull/3533)

workarounds.symptom: AnthropicModel: Claude Opus 5.5 rejected with 400 (temperature sent, not in model registry); AmazonBedrockModel unaffected
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(models): add Claude Opus 5.5 to the Anthropic registry (AmazonBedrockModel unchanged). Target files: deepeval/models/llms/constants.py, tests/test_core/test_models/test_anthropic_model.py, typescript/src/models/registry/models.json. Thanks for the quick turnaround on Opus 4.7 (#2617) and the later Claude entries. This adds the matching one for Claude Opus 5.5. (Ref: https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval/pull/3349)

workarounds.symptom: A node that is both a declared root and a child of another root runs multiple times, and KeyErrors in async
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dag): reject a root node that is reachable from another root. Target files: deepeval/metrics/dag/graph.py, tests/test_metrics/test_dag.py. Declaring a node as a root when it's also a child of another root gives it two ways in, so the runner visits it once per path. In sync mode the whole subtree runs again, which means the same LLM calls are made and the cost is counted twice over. In async mode it doesn't get that far — it raises `KeyError` while looking up the node's parent. (Ref: https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval/pull/3027)

workarounds.symptom: Gateway models send invalid strict JSON schemas for nested pydantic models
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(models): set additionalProperties recursively for gateway schemas. Target files: deepeval/models/llms/gateway_model.py, tests/test_core/test_models/test_openrouter_model.py. `DeepEvalOpenAICompatibleModel._schema_response_format` builds `response_format` by hand and sets `additionalProperties: false` only on the **root** schema object: (Ref: https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval/pull/2930)

workarounds.symptom: Conversational datasets fail to serialize ToolCall enums
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(dataset): serialize tool call enums in JSON mode. Target files: deepeval/dataset/utils.py, tests/test_core/test_datasets/test_dataset.py. Dataset saves fail when a `ToolCall` contains its default `ToolCallType` enum because Python-mode Pydantic dumps leave the enum object for `json.dumps()`. (Ref: https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval/pull/2926)
